overall: No violation on the late-minutes complaint: the complaint was filed before the 10-day deadline ran. The AG separately noted that the August 8 and 31 minutes were approved late, and reminded the Committee of its obligations.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to timely provide open session minutes (Aug 8, Aug 31, Sept 12) after her September request.
allegations.key_passage: Even though the Committee failed to timely respond to a request for minutes, at the time the complaint was filed, the Committee still had four days to timely respond to the request.

allegations.summary: Not alleged by the complainant; the AG raised it on its own: the August 8 and August 31 minutes were not approved within the timely-approval period.
allegations.key_passage: While the September 12 minutes were approved in a timely manner, the August 8 and August 31 minutes were not.
